boundary: first 25 cases of the english-v1 S1MB benchmarks whose questions are independent yes/no criteria over one input (go-emotions-noul-test-v1, civil-comments-noul-test-v1); each case is asked once as public Select over Label definitions taken from the benchmark's true-option descriptions and once as the equivalent named Checks of the same descriptions, select first. Gold is a membership only where the benchmark target is hard (0 or 1); soft targets are unlabelled. A community benchmark whose overlap with any judge's training data is unknown; pooled memberships are correlated within a case and are not independent samples

civil-comments-noul-test-v1.question: Which of these attributes does the comment have?

labels.toxicity: The comment is rude, disrespectful, or unreasonable in a way that is likely to make people leave a discussion.
labels.identity_attack: The comment attacks a person or group based on identity.
labels.sexual_explicit: The comment contains sexually explicit content.

go-emotions-noul-test-v1.question: Which emotions does the text express?

labels.neutral: The text expresses no identifiable emotion.
